moduleTitle: Module 5. Renal, Digestive, Metabolic, Immune and Reproductive Physiology

competencies.name: Multisystem integration case
competencies.can: Given a clinical scenario, trace the disturbance through at least three organ systems and identify the compensatory responses in the order they occur.

competencies.name: Exercise as an integrated response
competencies.can: Build an integrated account of moderate exercise across the muscular, cardiovascular, respiratory, endocrine, and renal systems.

competencies.name: Drawing based synthesis check
competencies.can: Draw and annotate a homeostatic pathway from memory and explain each step aloud or in writing without notes.
